verdict.rationale: WorkOS AuthKit documents social sign-in alongside SSO and passwords, explicitly naming Microsoft and Google 'and more'. Pricing states social login comes 'all from one integration' through a hosted UI, and SSO works with any SAML or OIDC IdP. Together these suggest providers are enabled through configuration rather than custom code. missing for 10: a documented list showing the breadth of supported social providers, explicit docs on dashboard-based configuration of social connections, and independent or hands-on corroboration of social login setup.
